subject: New from Rome: our new box, teal tiger's eye and two new guides
preheader: This week at the atelier: the Eternal City Jewelry box, new stones and guides to men's bracelets and stone meanings.
intro: This week in our atelier in Rome: the new box every piece now travels in, a fresh arrival of teal blue tiger's eye, a new 6 mm bracelet and two new guides.

items.title: Our new box
items.text: Every piece now arrives in the Eternal City Jewelry box, with its certificate. This is what you see when you open it.

items.title: New arrival: teal blue tiger's eye
items.text: Strands of 6 mm beads in deep sea-green and blue, with the moving light tiger's eye is known for. A first look before they become bracelets.

items.title: Rainbow Blue Tiger's Eye 6 mm bracelet
items.text: Our newest bracelet: shimmering blue tiger's eye, strung by hand in Rome. € 55.

items.title: Men's beaded bracelets: a guide
items.text: Which stones men choose, 10 or 12 mm beads, natural stone with sterling silver, and how to find your size.

items.title: What does your stone mean?
items.text: 30 stones grouped by intention: calm, confidence, love, protection and luck. Find the one that fits you.
